governed.config: betterleaks reads .betterleaks.toml (or .gitleaks.toml) from the folder it scans: the project decides which rules apply, its allowlists and its ignore file

suppressions.description: honored: a betterleaks:allow or gitleaks:allow comment on the line, and the fingerprints of .betterleaksignore

en.label: betterleaks (secrets)
en.purpose: Scans the project's files for secrets such as access tokens, passwords and private keys, from its built-in rules. A successor of gitleaks by the same author; the secret itself is hidden in the report.
en.limitation: It scans the files of the project, not its Git history, and does not check a found secret against its provider (that is switched off). It reads .betterleaks.toml or .gitleaks.toml from the project.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image: no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: betterleaks (segredos)
pt-BR.purpose: Procura nos arquivos do projeto segredos como tokens de acesso, senhas e chaves privadas, com suas regras embutidas. Sucessor do gitleaks, do mesmo autor; o segredo em si fica oculto no relatório.
pt-BR.limitation: Examina os arquivos do projeto, não o histórico do Git, e não confere o segredo encontrado com o provedor (isso fica desligado). Lê o .betterleaks.toml ou o .gitleaks.toml do projeto.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas: sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
